high_level_description: The image depicts a man standing on a wooden pier by the water during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm hues in the sky. The man is wearing a white, short-sleeved, collared shirt with a geometric pattern and matching white shorts. He has tattoos on his arms and legs, and he is accessorized with a silver chain necklace, a cross pendant, a bracelet, and a ring on his left hand. He is holding a glass of what looks like a cocktail in his right hand. In the background, there are several overwater bungalows with thatched roofs, suggesting a tropical or resort
